note: Recast from the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989), in English, which is itself recast from the original description of Ahmad 1955; only the soldier is described and measured, the alate and the pseudoworker are both marked Unknown in the original. Type locality Pishin, Balochistan, Pakistan.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale reddish brown, slightly darker anteriorly; mandibles dark reddish brown at the base, almost black apically; compound eyes whitish; pronotum brownish yellow; legs and abdomen pale cream. Head sparsely hairy; labrum with a few long hairs at the apex; anterior half of the postmentum with a few long and short hairs; pronotum with scattered short hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides converging anteriorly; its length about one and a half times its width; length to the mandibular base 2.11—2.25, maximum width 1.41—1.62 mm; frons sloping anteriorly. Compound eyes oval, their long diameter about equal to the antennal scape. Antenna 16 segments; segment 3 one and a half times as long as segment 4; segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3. Labrum wider than long, broadly lingulate, the sides nearly parallel. Mandibles rather long, stout; left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 well separated marginal teeth. Postmentum club-shaped, long; length 1.48—1.66, maximum width 0.70—0.78 mm; its anterior width twice the width of the waist; narrowest slightly below the middle. Pronotum wider than the head; maximum width 1.72—1.81, maximum length 0.83—1.04 mm; anterior margin weakly concave; anterolateral corners slightly bent; posterior margin nearly straight.
